zh.title: 在 GitHub，给下一次回来留一扇门。
zh.summary: 一个关于“有空再做”的小故事，从今天可以试的一步开始。
items: 中英文介绍与横版短片，陪你从午饭后的一张空白便签找起。
三张双语示例卡可以在本地运行；完整 24 张卡继续在官网阅读。
在 GitHub 关注版本更新，或把版本订阅加进常用的阅读器。

en.title: An open door on GitHub.
en.summary: A little story about “sometime”, and one small step you could try today.
items: English and Chinese introductions and landscape films begin with a blank note after lunch.
Three bilingual sample cards can run locally; the full 24-card collection stays on the official website.
Follow GitHub releases, or add the release feed to your usual reader.
